projects.name: Build a Local Notes Tool
projects.coreIntegration: Combine basic scripting, file handling, and clear documentation.

milestones.title: Define the behavior
milestones.description: Write the commands and expected results.

milestones.title: Build the tool
milestones.description: Create a small local command-line notes tool.

milestones.title: Test the tool
milestones.description: Run normal and invalid input cases.

milestones.title: Explain the result
milestones.description: Write a short explanation of the design and tradeoffs.

books.title: The Time Machine
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.assignment: Recall the main events from memory. Explain one idea about society that the story tests. Cite two passages by page or chapter. State one point that you reject or question. Connect the book to one modern system.

lessons.title: Contour and Proportion
lessons.concept: Observe the outer shape before you add detail.
lessons.practiceAssignment: Draw three household objects. Use five minutes for each drawing.
lessons.reviewPrompts: Which proportion was least accurate? What did you notice only after you drew it?

stages.title: Form
stages.goal: Use simple forms to represent volume.

lessons.title: Boxes, Cylinders, and Spheres
lessons.concept: Break a complex object into simple three-dimensional forms.
lessons.practiceAssignment: Choose two objects. Draw each object first as simple forms and then with basic detail.
lessons.reviewPrompts: Which simple form helped most? Where did the final drawing depart from the form study?

challenges.title: Five-Minute Object
challenges.prompt: Choose one safe object near you. Draw it for five minutes. Then write two observations that you missed before you started.

challenges.title: Form Breakdown
challenges.prompt: Choose one everyday object. Represent it with no more than four simple forms before you add detail.
